headline: MIA @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.72 at MIN 4.09, with a projected total of 8.81. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +0.85 runs while MIN moved -0.08, changing the projected margin by +0.93 runs. The projected total climbed +0.77, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -22.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed start-by-start logs were not available for every starter, so the page separates actual starts from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Ryan Jeffers, Austin Martin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Esteury Ruiz, Javier Sanoja because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
